question: Who is the 52nd Chief Justice of India?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Justice B R Gavai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Justice Bhushan Ramkrishna Gavai, the 52nd Chief Justice of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Justice Bhushan Ramkrishna Gavai** is the **52nd Chief Justice of India (CJI)**.

 
 
• 
 
Sworn in by **President Droupadi Murmu**.

 
 
• 
 
**Tenure:** Six months, ending **November 23, 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
**First Buddhist** and **second Dalit** (after K.G. Balakrishnan) to head the Indian judiciary.

 
 
• 
 
**Landmark Judgments (as SC judge):**

 
 
• 
 
**Article 370 abrogation** (upheld).

 
 
• 
 
**Electoral bonds scheme** (struck down).

 
 
• 
 
**2016 Demonetisation** (upheld).

 
 
• 
 
**Freedom of speech of public functionaries** (no extra restrictions).

 
 
• 
 
**Sub-classification within Scheduled Castes** for reservation (allowed).

 
 
• 
 
**Arbitration clause in unstamped agreements** (held valid, curable defect).
